# EstateFrame Digital

> AI real estate photo editing service with human quality control. We pair AI speed on HDR blending, sky swaps, virtual staging, item removal, and day-to-dusk conversion with a human editor who locks a stored style preset to your account, straightens verticals, and verifies every frame against an MLS compliance checklist before sign-off. Serving real estate photographers, agencies, and brokerages across the USA, Canada, UK, Australia, and New Zealand. Eight services. 12-hour SLA on photos. 24-hour SLA on staging. 2-hour rush. Credit on your next folder if we miss. Revisions free within the hour.

## What we do (eight services)

- **AI single image editing** — exposure, WB, perspective, MLS-ratio crops, human-verified style preset applied
- **AI HDR photo editing** — 3–7 bracketed exposures AI-blended, human-verified for straight verticals and honest window pull
- **AI day-to-dusk conversion** — daytime exteriors converted to twilight with AI-generated sky, human-verified light direction and MLS board rules
- **AI twilight enhancement** — real dusk captures AI-enriched, human-verified against the folder's style preset
- **AI virtual staging** — photorealistic AI furniture with human-verified scale, shadow, and MLS virtual-staging disclosure note
- **Real estate video editing** — gimbal, drone, agent footage cut into cinematic walkthroughs with AI color grade and human-verified pacing; horizontal 4K + vertical 9:16 delivered from one brief
- **AI item and object removal** — wires, cars, bins, cords, marks removed by AI with human QC against MLS permanent-fixture rules (what gets photographers delisted)
- **AI aerial and drone photo editing** — haze removal, horizon leveling, lens correction on DJI/Autel/Skydio captures

## Why AI + human beats AI-only editing

AI-only real estate photo editing tools fail on three things our workflow fixes:
1. **Style drift** — pure AI drifts across a 40-image shoot; frame 1 and frame 40 look like different photographers. Our human editor re-applies your stored style preset across the folder.
2. **MLS compliance** — AI will cheerfully remove permanent fixtures (ceiling fans, window grilles, built-in shelving) that MLS boards treat as misrepresentation. Agents get delisted. Our human QC runs every frame against published MLS rules per market.
3. **Generic look** — AI flattens every photographer into the same "Zillow look." Our style memory keeps your folder in your voice.

- **United States** — MLS-ready delivery for Compass, Coldwell Banker, Keller Williams, RE/MAX, Sotheby's International Realty, Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices, Zillow Premier Agent, and independent brokerages.
- **Canada** — Realtor.ca and TRREB workflows for Royal LePage, Century 21 Canada, Sutton, Re/Max Canada, Chestnut Park, and independents.
- **United Kingdom** — Rightmove, Zoopla, OnTheMarket upload specs for London, South East, Midlands, and North estate agency photographers.
- **Australia** — realestate.com.au, Domain.com.au, Rate My Agent delivery for Ray White, LJ Hooker, Harcourts, Belle Property, McGrath Estate Agents, and independent photographers.
- **New Zealand** and worldwide via cloud link.

## The service level agreement

- **12-hour SLA** on photo folders — credit on your next folder if we miss.
- **24-hour SLA** on AI virtual staging and twilight enhancement.
- **2-hour rush** on hero frames — no surcharge.
- **3–5 business days** on video edits.
- **Revisions** free and returned within 60 minutes, unlimited passes.

## How the workflow works

1. **Style memory onboarding** — share 15–20 of your finished edits. We extract your WB, contrast, sky, sharpening, and crop preferences into a stored style preset locked to your account.
2. **Transfer** — RAW folder via any cloud link (Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, OneDrive, pCloud, MASV). Confirmation inside an hour.
3. **AI pre-pass + human QC** — AI handles HDR blends, sky swaps, staging, item removal; human editor locks style preset, verifies verticals, runs MLS compliance checklist.
4. **SLA delivery** — print master + MLS-ready export, named to your convention, delivered inside the SLA. Credit if we miss.

## Payment

USD, CAD, AUD, GBP, NZD, INR via Stripe, Wise, PayPal, or international bank transfer. Net 15 invoice terms by default. Monthly subscription available for 500+ images/month at discounted rates.
